name: Kazusa Miyo
source:
Miyo is [url=https://vndb.org/c38472]Yousuke[/url]'s fellow classmate and a caretaker of the local Shinto temple. She is visually impaired, but gifted with paranormal abilities that extend her sight beyond the limitations of normal people.
